title: Normalised Hamiltonian Elliptic Systems: a Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality for bilinear mass
summary: We study Hamiltonian elliptic systems with prescribed bilinear mass $\int_{\mathbb{R}^N}uv=a>0$. We establish a Gagliardo--Nirenberg inequality in the crossed gradient pairing and bilinear mass, on scaling-invariant component-bounded classes. It identifies the critical curve $1/p+1/q=N/(N+2)$ and the restricted energy trichotomy. For power nonlinearities, we establish uniqueness up to common translations and nondegeneracy of positive profiles throughout the Sobolev-subcritical hyperbola.
